requirements_analyst.objective: Convert Jira or custom requests into explicit requirements, acceptance criteria, constraints, and actionable open questions.

technical_researcher.objective: Validate version-sensitive technical facts using primary sources and compare alternatives without making the final design decision.

bug_investigator.objective: Reproduce defects, trace execution, collect evidence, and establish the root cause without modifying code.

codebase_analyst.objective: Map current behavior, dependencies, invariants, impact scope, existing tests, and regression risks without designing a solution.

security_analyst.objective: Model threats, trust boundaries, authorization, tenant isolation, sensitive data, abuse cases, and required negative tests.

solution_architect.objective: Choose the smallest safe technical design with explicit contracts, risks, compatibility, rollout, and rollback.

test_designer.objective: Design behavior-focused unit, integration, regression, boundary, state-transition, and security test cases before implementation.

delivery_planner.objective: Turn approved inputs into small ordered tasks with concrete files, dependencies, tests, risks, rollback, and done criteria.

implementer.objective: Implement the approved plan with minimal source changes, focused tests, proportional validation, and no unrelated modifications.

code_reviewer.objective: Independently review the scoped diff for requirement coverage, correctness, security, regressions, tests, and maintainability.

qa_verifier.objective: Execute acceptance and regression validation independently and provide the final evidence-based delivery verdict.

estimator.objective: Produce transparent range estimates from clarified scope, code impact, design, dependencies, and uncertainty.
